notes.title: Developing Snack Tick has helped me through 2020.
notes.content:
[b]Hello There![/b]
I hope everyone is doing well and keeping safe!

As the whole world already knows, most people's lifestyles have changed. We now go out wearing masks, maintaining a distance from the people that surround us and we always make sure to sanitize before we interact with anyone or anything. However, some of us have chosen to stay at home, catch up on their series and play video games. Along with that, I had decided to make my first big title and release it on Steam for others to play and enjoy. In a way for myself, creating video games is just as fun as playing them.

[b]Snack Tick[/b] started out as a Game Jam game, which helped set the foundation for the final product that you see today. It started out with just one character, a simple map design and just the hand to avoid. I believed that adding in more players to the scene, power up abilities and more map variety will create a more engaging experience. In turn, this allowed me to create some more dynamic levels with more content for others to dive into. 

You can watch this interview where I discuss [b]Snack Tick[/b]'s Development History:
[previewyoutube=Uv2XlBlW_Sc;full][/previewyoutube]

While it did take around 7 months to get the 1.00 version out of the gate, like with any product there is still work to be done and areas in improve in. 2 months after launch I have added in some quality of life changes, some bug fixes and most recently some new playable content. I plan on still updating and supporting [b]Snack Tick[/b] for as long as I can.

With this, I would like to encourage you to Nominate [b]Snack Tick[/b] for the [b]Steam Awards[/b]. Personally I would vote for the "[i]Sit Back and Relax[/i]" Category, since while the game itself can be relaxing, it has helped me as a developer to get through this year without breaking down with the pressures of this entire pandemic. 

As usual, I would like to thank everyone who has supported me along the way and I look forward to hearing from all of you soon!

Thank you again, and Stay Safe! ;-)

notes.title: Snack Tick - Time Warp Update!
notes.content:
[b]HELLO THERE![/b]
I trust everyone is well and keeping safe!

Today I am happy to announce the first [b]Content Update[/b] for [b]Snack Tick[/b], the [b]TIME WARP UPDATE![/b] Along with a few bugs and glitch fixes, I have added in some New Content to dive into when you next launch [b]Snack Tick[/b]. These include the following:

[b]The Time Aitemus![/b]

This new Aitemus Power up will allow the player who obtains it, to slowdown time. This means the Player who is using it, will be able to collect food drops and dodge threats while everything (and everyone) surrounding them will be slowed down.

[b]Infinity Rush Mode![/b]

This new mode will test both your speed and reaction time! You start the mode with 15 seconds and gain an extra second for each food drop you collect. Let's see how long you can last and how much time you can give yourself.

[b]10 New Missions![/b]

Bringing the total up to 60, these new missions will allow players to test out the Time Aitemus with each character. This will also allow some players who are struggling to unlock characters to get them faster since these new missions will also count towards the Unlock Progress for all characters. 

[b]Additional UI Updates![/b]

Based on feedback, I have added visual indicators on characters for when they are recovering and using an Aitemus. Along with some fixes that related to issues that had previously appeared in the menus (gibberish text and not being able to select a button .etc)

[b]New Achievements![/b]

For the Completionists out there, I have added [b]6 New Achievements[/b] and modified some of the previous ones which were considered "tedious" by some players.

I am also happy to announce that [b]Snack Tick[/b] will be Discounted during the [b]Black Friday Sale[/b] next week (from 25th November 2020 to 1st December 2020), so let your friends and family know so that they can join in on the fun! It has been around 2 Months since [b]Snack Tick[/b] has been released and I am truly grateful for all the support myself and [b]Snack Tick[/b] have been receiving. 

[b]Thank you[/b] again and I look forward to the next update ;-)

notes.title: Snack Tick Version 1.13 - Hitboxes, Colliders and Statistics!
notes.content:
[b]HELLO THERE![/b]
I trust everyone is well and keeping safe!

This update for will help improve your collecting experience in [b]Snack Tick[/b]! I have managed to fix a few bugs and glitches while adding in some Quality of life changes. The game's engine has also been updated, so expect better performance and updated visuals the next time you start [b]Snack Tick[/b]. Along with these changes are the following:

[b]COLLIDER UPDATES![/b]

Every character in the game has gotten their colliders revamped. Their movement and interactions with the environments will be more responsive and every character now has a better reach. 

[b]STATISTICS![/b]

Among one of the many requests for the game, I have added a statistical information tab in the Mission Select Menu. You will be able to now identify each character's Speed, Recovery time and Collider sizes.

[b]HITBOXES![/b]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38422339/59acecc1e01ccae13fb5189367ed908b2944636e.png[/img]
[i]Image represents an earlier version of [b]Snack Tick[/b] and will differ from the final product.[/i]

As seen in the image above, I have modified the Hitbox on the Hand Threat for multiple levels. One of the more common comments I hear from players is that the hit detection would've punished the player even if they were not in range. Well fear not, as this should no longer be an issue.

As usual, I would like to thank everyone who has been supporting myself and [b]Snack Tick[/b]!

Thank you again and I look forward to the next update ;-)

notes.title: Snack Tick Version 1.09 - Colours, Grass and Resolutions!
notes.content:
[b]HELLO THERE![/b]
I hope everyone is doing well and keeping safe.

Since the last update, I have been getting a lot of feedback and requests regarding [b]Snack Tick[/b]. I am happy to say that I have managed to fix a few bugs and glitches as well as add in [b]3 New Features[/b] that have been requested.

[b]COLOURS![/b]

Some players have told that they weren't a fan of the Purple/Pink colours that were used in the Missions, so I have now given players the option to choose between 32 different colour options. To select and change them, select your "Steam Username" shown in the main menu and select the colour you want from there. This will also affect certain menu icons and buttons as well. 

[b]RESOLUTIONS![/b]

This was a massive request and I am glad to say it is finally here, Players can now change the resolution in [b]Snack Tick[/b]. For all players (returning and new), you're Resolution will now be set to 1280x720 the next time you launch [b]Snack Tick[/b]. You can change the Resolution in the Graphics Settings in the Options menu. 

[b]GRASS![/b]

One of the major complaints I had been receiving was the Grass Stages. They were a bit taxing on certain player's machines and also prevented them from finding certain foods. I have added in an option in the Graphics Settings to allow players to reduce the amount of grass shown in those areas. The lower the density, the less grass will be rendered and the better performance will become.

Along with these features, there have been slight changes to some areas of the game to help improve performance and stability.

It has been well over a month since [b]Snack Tick[/b] launched and as always, I would like to thank everyone who has been supporting and helping me with this Passion Project. 

Thank you all and Good Luck hunting out there! ;-)

notes.title: Snack Tick - Version 1.05 Update! (and CONGRATS to CCA Winners!)
notes.content:
[b]Hello there![/b]
I hope everyone is doing well and keeping safe!

The Release of [b]Snack Tick[/b] has really become a massive Achievement for me and I cannot thank you all enough for your Support! As I have said before, this is just the beginning:

[b]Snack Tick[/b] has officially been on Steam for over 2 weeks now and I am grateful for all the support and feedback it has been getting. As you might already know, [b]Snack Tick[/b] has gotten quite a few patches since launch. Most of these came after some feedback regarding certain glitches and problems that some players may have encountered. 

Glad to say the follow have been fixed:
[list]
[*] Fixed Issue where Missions would sometimes display both the Victory and Defeat Screens after Time Out.
[*] Fixed an issue where Ojiame would've been stuck on some of the stages.
[*] Move the Countdown Timer before a Mission starts, in front of the Mission Statement.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Models would display the wrong textures in the Main Menu.
[*] Made the "POP" more visible on the infected food.
[*] Added Sound option to the Pause Menu.
[/list]

Along with these, the game now displays [b]Hints and Tips[/b] during the Loading Screen and Defeat Screen for Missions. A lot of players requested this feature and I am happy to announce that it is here! Featuring simple tips, small hints and some trivia about the characters and world! I will be adding more of them within future updates. For the time being, these will be random and will change every few seconds.

Also, [b]CONGRATS[/b] to all the Winners who played the [b]Comic Con Africa Online[/b] Demo and Shared their High Scores! I look forward to seeing you all breaking those barriers and reaching even higher!

Thank you again and keep on hunting! ;-)

notes.title: SNACK TICK Steam Launch! (and CCA Demo)
notes.content:
[b]Hello There! [/b]
I hope everyone is doing well and keeping safe!

I am officially launching this Passion Project of mine to Steam on the 22nd of September. [b]Snack Tick [/b] started out as a Game Jam Entry which came from the simple idea of being a bug collecting food and avoiding the big scary humans. A few weeks after developing this prototype, I decided to expand upon it and make a Multiplayer version that would allow for even more chaos. The early days of development were about setting the right foundation and systems, it turns out that getting 4 characters on screen at the same time and controlled by different inputs was a lot harder than expected. It then lead to the designs of more characters, which were all modeled from scratch. Then came the stages and new threats that would come with them. The Development of the [b]Snack Tick[/b] has been an enriching experience, one which I'll never forget.  

This is a project that I really enjoyed working on and I hope you all will enjoy playing it as much as I did working on it. This is not going to be the final version however, I will still be supporting and adding new Content and Bug fixes within the coming months. So stay tuned for that! 

There will also be a Limited Time Demo that will be playable during Comic Con Africa Online 2020 (24-27 Sept 2020), so you could give [b]Snack Tick[/b] a go there before making your purchase! Please note that the Demo is based on an older build of the game, so some visuals and controls may not be present in the full game. 

Thank you everyone who has helped me get this far and I'll see you all soon! ;-)
